name: @miadi/stateloom-web-source
//: This is the designer's SOURCE and is never published — hence private: true.
What ships is its BUILD: `next build` (output: standalone) produces
@miadi/stateloom-web` runs this app without a Next.js toolchain anywhere.
Until 2026-08-16 this package was also called `stateloom-web`, and two
different things answering to one name is why it kept looking as though the
designer was the one package nobody had published.
The version here is the DESIGNER's version, reported by `stateloom-web
--version` as `designer`. Bump it with web-dist's when the canvas changes.
